# Code of Conduct

Repotify follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful and welcoming, give and take feedback gracefully, and focus on what is best for the people who
use Repotify. Harassment, insults and personal attacks are not tolerated in issues, pull requests or any other project
space.

To report a problem, contact the maintainer through a
[private advisory](https://github.com/repotify/repotify/security/advisories/new) and mark it as a conduct report. Reports
are handled confidentially. The maintainer may remove content or block people who break these rules.
